text: I'm so sorry to message this late, I know you must be busy. My grandson is 2 and he's got 38.3 and he's been saying his throat hurts, pointing at it, though he's still drinking his milk and water okay. The thing that's worrying me is some little dark spots. He's got dark skin so I wasn't sure at first, but I looked at the palms of his hands and the bottoms of his feet and inside his lip and there are tiny reddish purple dots there. I pressed a glass on them like I read about and they didn't fade at all. Sorry if I'm making a fuss, I just didn't know who else to ask.
